lines.japanese:
忍が生まれてはじめて、学校に通いだした頃の出
来事だ。
lines.english: This happened when Shinobu first began going to school.

lines.japanese: 学校帰り、忍は悲鳴を聞いて立ち止まった。
lines.english: On his way home from school, Shinobu heard a scream and stopped.

lines.japanese:
周囲を見渡す。
　草むらの向こうが、わずかに揺らめいた。
lines.english: He looked around. Something stirred faintly beyond the tall grass.

lines.japanese:
そちらに足を向ける。
　日常とは不釣り合いな、切迫した悲鳴だったのだ。
lines.english: He headed toward it. It was an urgent scream, out of place in the everyday world.

lines.japanese:
移動する。
　数人の子供の頭が、草むらから交互に突き出ていた。
lines.english: He drew closer. Several children’s heads appeared in turn above the grass.

lines.japanese:
剣呑な雰囲気。
　忍は素早く身を低める。
　気取られぬよう、朽ちた古木に身を重ねた。
lines.english: There was menace in the air. Shinobu quickly crouched low. Keeping himself hidden, he pressed against the trunk of a rotting old tree.

lines.japanese: いじめが行われていた。
lines.english: Someone was being bullied.

lines.japanese:
一人を、複数が囲んで押さえつけている。
　遊び半分という雰囲気はない。
　荒い息づかいと、余裕のない熱気が渦巻いていた。
lines.english: Several children had surrounded one child and pinned him down. There was nothing playful about it. Harsh breathing and feverish desperation churned in the air.

lines.japanese:
いじめる側が興奮に浮かされているのではないか。
　忍はそう感じ取った。
lines.english: The tormentors seemed drunk on their own excitement. That was how it struck Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「やめろ！　やめ―――ッッッ！」
lines.english: “Stop! Sto—aaagh!”

lines.japanese: いじめられているらしい少年が、口を押さえられた。
lines.english: Someone clamped a hand over the mouth of the boy they seemed to be bullying.

lines.japanese: 「脱がせ脱がせ！」
lines.english: “Strip him! Strip him!”

lines.japanese: 「全部はがせ！」
lines.english: “Rip it all off!”

lines.japanese:
六人がかりだ。
　下の少年は必死になって暴れるが、押さえつけら
れて逃れられない。
lines.english: There were six of them. The boy underneath fought with all his strength, but they held him down. He could not break free.

lines.japanese: 口を封じられる。
lines.english: They smothered his cries.

lines.japanese: 「んんーーーーーーーーっ！？」
lines.english: “Mmmmmmph?!”

lines.japanese:
大地に磔にされ、四肢それぞれを押さえられてし
まう。
lines.english: They crucified him against the earth, one child pinning down each limb.

lines.japanese: 無数の手が伸びた。
lines.english: Hands reached in from every side.

lines.japanese: 「んーーーーーーーーーーッッッ！！」
lines.english: “Mmmmmmmmmph!!”

lines.japanese: 「いてっ！」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 口を押さえていた少年が、飛び跳ねた。
lines.english: The boy who had been covering the victim's mouth leaped back.

lines.japanese: 「こいつ噛みやがったっ！　ざけんなっ！」
lines.english: “The little shit bit me! Screw you!”

lines.japanese: 頬を張った。
lines.english: He slapped the victim across the face.

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃっ！」
lines.english: “Agh!”

lines.japanese: 二度。三度。
lines.english: Twice. Three times.

lines.japanese: 四度。
lines.english: Four.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううう……」
lines.english: “Uh… uhhh…”

lines.japanese: それで、大人しくなった。
lines.english: That quieted the victim down.

lines.japanese: 「今のうちに脱がせ！」
lines.english: “Get those clothes off—now!”

lines.japanese:
狂乱は過ぎ去らない。
　衣類が引きはがされていく。
lines.english: The frenzy did not abate. They tore the victim's clothes away.

lines.japanese: 「見ろよ、ついてねー！」
lines.english: “Look! There's nothing there!”

lines.japanese:
大柄な少年が、全裸にされた少年の両足首をつか
んで持ち上げた。
lines.english: A large boy seized the naked child by both ankles and hauled him up.

lines.japanese:
矮躯が軽々と持ち上がる。逆様に。
　股間を空にさらして、数人がかりで宙づりにされた。
lines.english: The small body rose effortlessly. Upside down. Crotch bared to the sky, the child dangled in the grip of several boys.

lines.japanese: 「いやぁぁぁぁぁーっ！？」
lines.english: “Nooooooooo!”

lines.japanese:
耳をつんざく悲鳴。
　忍は知った。
lines.english: The scream split the air. And Shinobu understood.

lines.japanese: 少女だったのだ―――
lines.english: The child was a girl—

lines.japanese: 忍はその証を見た。
lines.english: Shinobu saw the proof.

lines.japanese: 「男みてーな格好してもムダなんだよ！」
lines.english: “Dressing like a boy won't fool anyone!”

lines.japanese:
少年たちは笑いあう。
　子供特有の甲高い、だが下世話な色にまみれた笑
いだった。
lines.english: The boys laughed among themselves. It was the shrill laughter peculiar to children, but drenched in vulgarity.

lines.japanese:
察するところ、少女は幾度となくこうした行為を
受けているらしい。
lines.english: From what he could gather, this was hardly the first time the girl had been subjected to this.

lines.japanese:
ズボンを掃いていたのは対策としてか。
　だが力づくにされては、どうしようもなかった。
　六対一では、抵抗のしようもない。
lines.english: Perhaps the pants had been meant as a defense. But against brute force, there was nothing she could do. Six against one left no chance to resist.

lines.japanese: 「おい、どうするよ？」
lines.english: “So what do we do with her?”

lines.japanese:
リーダー格が仲間に問いかける。
　その瞬間、硫黄の噴出を思わせる、むっとした悪
意が辺りを満たした。
lines.english: The apparent ringleader put the question to the others. In that instant, a stifling malice filled the air, like a burst of sulfur.

lines.japanese: （まずい……）
lines.english: (This is bad…)

lines.japanese:
逆さ吊りにされた少女。
　その視線が、偶然忍をとらえた。
lines.english: The girl hung upside down. By chance, her eyes found Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 交差する視線。
lines.english: Their gazes crossed.

lines.japanese:
強い怯えがそこにある。
　わずかな期待のようなものが仄見える。
lines.english: Her eyes were full of terror. And beneath it, the faintest glimmer of hope.

lines.japanese:
忍は動けなかった。
　動いたとしても、六人相手に効果的な行動ができ
たかどうか。
lines.english: Shinobu could not move. Even if he did, could he do anything effective against six of them?

lines.japanese:
そもそも忍には関係ない出来事、ただのいじめな
のだ。
lines.english: This had nothing to do with him in the first place. It was only bullying.

lines.japanese: 下手に助けては巻き添えになることもあるだろう。
lines.english: If he tried to help, he might only be dragged into it himself.

lines.japanese: （でも……助けないと……）
lines.english: (But… I have to help her…)

lines.japanese: 忍の思考は、短時間完全に停止していた。
lines.english: For a brief moment, Shinobu's mind went completely blank.

lines.japanese:
一歩下がる。
　枯れ木を踏んだ。
lines.english: He took one step back. A dead branch snapped underfoot.

lines.japanese:
小さな音だった。
　だというのにそれは、ことさら大きく響いた。
　静まりかえる。
lines.english: It was a tiny sound. And yet it sounded unnaturally loud. Everything went still.

lines.japanese: 六対の視線は忍の位置を、正確に射抜いた。
lines.english: Six pairs of eyes found his hiding place with perfect accuracy.
“Who's there?”

lines.japanese:
互いに目配せする。
　六人は渦中にいる。誰もはぐれていない。
　ならば、草むらにいる者は誰なのか。
lines.english: They exchanged glances. All six were right there. No one had wandered off. Then who was hiding in the grass?

lines.japanese: 「おい、誰か見てこいよ」
lines.english: “Hey. Somebody go look.”

lines.japanese: 二人ほどが頷き、近づいてくる。
lines.english: Two of them nodded and began to approach.

lines.japanese: （どうする？　このままだと……）
lines.english: (What do I do? At this rate…)

lines.japanese:
立った瞬間、見られる。
　下手をしたら顔を記憶されるかも知れない。
lines.english: They would see him the instant he stood up. Worse, they might remember his face.

lines.japanese: 逃げ切れればともかく、もし捕まったら。
lines.english: Running might work. But what if they caught him?

lines.japanese: （このあたりの地理、まだ全然詳しくない……）
lines.english: (I hardly know this area at all…)

lines.japanese: きっかり一秒考えて、忍は息を吸った。
lines.english: Shinobu thought for exactly one second, then drew breath.

lines.japanese: そして叫んだ。
lines.english: And shouted.

lines.japanese: 「先生、こっちです！」
lines.english: “Teacher! Over here!”

lines.japanese:
少年たちの緊迫感が、一気に高まった。
　全員の動きが停止した。
lines.english: The tension among the boys spiked at once. Every one of them froze.

lines.japanese:
そして忍の発した『先生』という単語に、ひどく
動揺を見せた。
lines.english: The single word—teacher—had shaken them badly.

lines.japanese:
張りつめた糸が切れる。
　一斉に逃げ出したのだ。
lines.english: The taut thread snapped. They all bolted at once.

lines.japanese: 「またやってやるからな！」
lines.english: “We'll get you again!”

lines.japanese: ズボンと下着を持ったまま、彼らは逃げ去っていく。
lines.english: They fled with her pants and underwear still in their hands.

lines.japanese: ほとんど全裸の少女が残されていた。
lines.english: The girl was left behind, almost entirely naked.

lines.japanese: （放っておけない）
lines.english: (I can't just leave her.)

lines.japanese:
ここまで関わったら、もう同じである。
　地べたに座り込み口元の血をぬぐっている少女に、
声をかけた。
lines.english: He was already involved. There was no changing that now. The girl sat on the bare earth, wiping blood from her mouth. He spoke to her.

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫？」
lines.english: “Are you all right?”

lines.japanese:
局部を隠しもせず、俯いている。
　忍などいないかのように無視している。
lines.english: She sat with her head bowed, making no attempt to cover herself. She ignored Shinobu as if he were not even there.

lines.japanese: （困ったな……どうしよう）
lines.english: (This is a problem… What do I do?)

lines.japanese: 忍は残されたシャツを拾った。
lines.english: Shinobu picked up the shirt they had left behind.

lines.japanese:
むしり取られたためか、ボタンが取れている。
　手渡す。
lines.english: The buttons had come off, probably when they tore it from her. He held it out.

lines.japanese:
少女は忍を睨んだ。
　直接的な憎悪を向けられる覚えはない。
lines.english: The girl glared at Shinobu. He could think of no reason for such direct hatred.

lines.japanese:
だが少女には、他に術はなかったのだろう。
　助けてくれた忍に、敵意を向けた。
lines.english: But perhaps she had nowhere else to turn it. So she turned her hostility on the boy who had helped her.

lines.japanese:
咄嗟に視線をそらした忍は、そこにぶちまけられ
中身が散乱した鞄を見つけた。
lines.english: Shinobu reflexively looked away and saw a schoolbag lying upended nearby, its contents scattered everywhere.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ！」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 突然、少女は叫ぶ。
lines.english: The girl suddenly shouted.

lines.japanese:
「なに黙ってんだよ！
　なにか言いたいことがあんだろ！」
lines.english: “Why won’t you say anything?! You’ve got something to say, don’t you?”

lines.japanese: 叫ぶうち、アーモンド型の瞳はゆらぎ、溢れてくる。
lines.english: As she shouted, her almond-shaped eyes wavered, filling until the tears spilled over.

lines.japanese:
「いじめがそんなに珍しいのかよ！
　それとも、おまえもいじめたいのか！」
lines.english: “Never seen somebody get picked on before?! Or do you want a turn too?”

lines.japanese:
「やりたきゃやれよ！
　あいつらの仲間になりたかったらやれよ！」
lines.english: “Then go on! Do it! If you want to be one of them, go on and do it!”

lines.japanese:
忍は答えられなかった。
　鋭い痛みだけが、言葉に変換されて伝わってきた。
lines.english: Shinobu could not answer. Only the sharp pain came through, translated into words.

lines.japanese:
「ちょっと変なやつ探して、みんなでいじめて……
　でも次は自分の番かもしれないってびびってて」
lines.english: “You all find somebody a little weird and gang up on them… but you're scared stiff you'll be next.”

lines.japanese:
「……あたしはそんな奴らに何されたって平気なん
　だからな！」
lines.english: “…Whatever people like that do to me, it doesn't bother me!”

lines.japanese:
「服だってお母さんがいっぱい買ってくれるし、
　破かれたって惜しくないし、全然きかねーよ！」
lines.english: “My mom buys me tons of clothes anyway, so who cares if they get ripped? You can't hurt me!”

lines.japanese: 「さあやれよ！　やってみろ！」
lines.english: “Come on, then! Try it!”

lines.japanese:
「でもそれはおまえが弱いってことなんだからな！
　弱いやつだから、人をいじめるってことなんだか
　らな！」
lines.english: “But that'd just prove you're weak too! Weaklings are the ones who have to pick on people—that's all it means!”

lines.japanese: 「それでもいいなら、殴るなり蹴るなりしろよぉ！」
lines.english: “If you’re fine with that, then hit me! Kick me!”

lines.japanese:
激昂は途切れた。
　涙はもう限界水位を超えてしまっていた。
lines.english: Her fury broke off. The tears had already risen past the point where she could contain them.

lines.japanese: 「……すんっ」
lines.english: “…Snf.”

lines.japanese:
鼻をすする。
　そして萎むような声で、
lines.english: She sniffed. Then, in a voice that seemed to crumple in on itself—

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ……おまえ……」
lines.english: “What… are you?”

lines.japanese:
うつむいた。
　肩をゆすって、嗚咽をこらえる。
lines.english: She bowed her head. Her shoulders shook as she fought back her sobs.

lines.japanese:
忍はただ見つめていた。
　かすかな困惑。
lines.english: Shinobu only watched her. A faint bewilderment stirred in him.

lines.japanese:
経路の理解できない涙。
　目の前の少女が、ただ遠い。
lines.english: Tears whose path he could not understand. The girl before him seemed impossibly far away.

lines.japanese: 「……うっ、うくっ……んっ……」
lines.english: “…Hh… ngh… mm…”

lines.japanese:
忍は鞄の中から、まだ新しい体育用のジャージを
出した。
lines.english: Shinobu took a nearly new school tracksuit from his bag and held it out.

lines.japanese: 「……ほっといてよ」
lines.english: “…Leave me alone.”

lines.japanese:
一転して弱々しく、受け取らない。
　さらけだされた部分を隠す気力もないのか。
lines.english: All at once, she seemed small and weak. She would not take it. Perhaps she no longer had even the strength to cover herself.

lines.japanese:
ただ大きな瞳に悔し涙をためて、虚ろに地面を見
つめている。
lines.english: She only stared hollowly at the ground, her great eyes brimming with frustrated tears.

lines.japanese: 「いいから、かまわないで」
lines.english: “I said leave me alone.”

lines.japanese:
だが下半身をむきだしのまま、帰ることはできな
いだろう。
lines.english: But she could hardly go home with the lower half of her body still exposed.

lines.japanese: ジャージをそっと下に置いた。
lines.english: He gently laid the tracksuit on the ground.

lines.japanese: 「……もっとうまくやらないとダメだ」
lines.english: “…You have to handle it better than this.”

lines.japanese:
そんなことを言うと、少女はまたも火をつけられ
たような勢いで叫んだ。
lines.english: At that, the girl screamed again, as though he had set her alight.

lines.japanese: 「うるせーよ！　関係ないってんだろぉ！」
lines.english: “Shut up! I told you it's none of your business!”

lines.japanese:
「行けよ！　行けよバカ、いつおまえなんかに助け
　てくれって頼んだよ！　おまえなんてしらねーし、
　なんの、なんのっ―――」
lines.english: “Go away! Go away, idiot! When did I ever ask somebody like you to help me? I don't even know you! You're—you're just—just—”

lines.japanese:
あとはもう言葉にならない。
　泣き声はもらさない。
　決壊はしない。
lines.english: After that, the words would no longer come. She would not let herself cry aloud. She would not break.

lines.japanese:
ただうずくまって、嗚咽だけを幾度も幾度も呑み
込んでいた。
lines.english: She only crouched there, swallowing one sob after another, again and again.

lines.japanese:
暴風雨のような屈辱を、胎内に押さえ込もうとし
ていた。
lines.english: She was trying to cage a storm of humiliation inside her own body.

lines.japanese: それは自分との戦いだ。
lines.english: It was a battle against herself.
(…This girl…)

lines.japanese:
今、どんな手を差し伸べても、彼女は傷つくだろ
うと思った。
lines.english: He thought that anything he offered her now would only wound her further.

lines.japanese:
忍はきびすを返し、立ち去った。
　視覚と聴覚から、少女を排除するために。
lines.english: Shinobu turned on his heel and left. To remove the girl from his sight and hearing.
